reviews_1s:
Shipped to me without the lidThis jar is advertised as a 60 oz and it is barely 45 oz. I bought this for my bath salts (which stick to the side of this jar) and it doesn't hold my 48 ounce bag of bath salts. But 60 oz would! It’s very frustrating when things aren’t as advertised. I should have read the reviews. You would think they would change the false advertisement by now.A 3 lb bag of epsom salt (48 oz) will not fit in this jar. Just FYI that the size is inaccurate. It’s marked as a 60oz jar in the description and on the box, but it won’t hold that amount.The description says these are for the bath and aromatherapy. I started using these in March for storing epsom salts. But right away the salt coated the container and etched into the acrylic. I tried soaking them in hot water to remove the salt. I tried scraping the salt off the sides, but it is etched into the sides.
Because the salt is etched into the container, I can't use these for anything else. I can't store cotton pads, nor any textile. I can't use it for storing food. They are ruined and useless.
Too late to return them for a refund. So disappointed.I didn’t receive a lid only the jar and it’s a lightweight plasticAbsolutely crap; size is too small, costs $6 to return.
Check Store; just because it's through Amazon, doesn't mean it's a free return.This container is much smaller than the picture. I was very disappointed in mine.
